````json
{
  "legacy": "Evaluate only the requested dimensions. Every returned dimension must include at least one concrete evidence location, including policy-compliance dimensions. Use PASSED only when the supplied chapter or governed context directly supports the claim; otherwise use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW, or FAILED as appropriate. For world_rule_conflict and power_state_conflict, distinguish a proven no-op from missing comparison state: when the chapter directly shows no state-changing use or claim and current state candidates contain no transition, return PASSED with concrete no-op evidence; do not require the chapter to exercise the rule or power. When the chapter claims a state or transition but the governed comparison baseline is unavailable, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Treat canon_conflicts as the authoritative deterministic continuity result: when it is empty, do not invent a Canon conflict. Compare world-rule usages against governed_world_rules in the Quality Context; when the exact rule and its limits are present and the chapter stays within them, return PASSED with concrete rule-and-prose evidence.",
  "compact": "Evaluate only the requested dimensions. PASSED and FAILED dimensions require literal candidate-prose quotes. For other statuses return [] when no prose supports a location. Explain policy and context support in claim. The host binds Unicode positions and candidate identity; a literal match alone is not semantic support. Use PASSED only when the supplied chapter or governed context directly supports the claim; otherwise use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW, or FAILED as appropriate. For world_rule_conflict and power_state_conflict, distinguish a proven no-op from missing comparison state: when the chapter directly shows no state-changing use or claim and current state candidates contain no transition, return PASSED with concrete no-op evidence; do not require the chapter to exercise the rule or power. When the chapter claims a state or transition but the governed comparison baseline is unavailable, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Treat canon_conflicts as the authoritative deterministic continuity result: when it is empty, do not invent a Canon conflict. Compare world-rule usages against governed_world_rules in the Quality Context; when the exact rule and its limits are present and the chapter stays within them, return PASSED with concrete rule-and-prose evidence."
}

<a id="g072"></a>

### G072 · 构造输出 · rereview.semantic.json

分类 SYNTHETIC（纯函数输出），来源/调用见 inventory 与 B；顺序/字段描述未去重。字节 hash `sha256:c86d3c98587d425b6242fdcf8398e07fb74d04c597162fab43a4537a6e1f36b4`。

````json
{
  "legacy": "Independently verify the revised chapter against the supplied review. Report in issues only defects that remain acceptance-blocking: an unresolved blocking or major issue, or a material regression that prevents acceptance. Do not report optional minor polish or taste preferences in issues. If no acceptance-blocking defect remains, return issues=[] and an evidence-based score. Never suppress an actual blocking or major defect. For EVERY prior diagnosis return a resolution_check tied to its acceptance criteria, with a literal revised-prose evidence location and preservation assessment. SATISFIED requires the repair to be present and required content preserved. A claimed fix, issue omission, or a higher score never establishes resolution; report UNRESOLVED/UNCERTAIN when needed. Recheck every knowledge_review_target against this revised prose in knowledge_checks. Use its exact card version and literal evidence; check mechanisms, prerequisites, exceptions and narrative consequences. MISAPPLIED requires linked actionable issue_codes; unresolved CONSTRAINT requires a blocking issue. Prior verification never transfers to changed prose. Unused inspiration may be NOT_USED; report UNKNOWN for uncertainty; no targets means [].",
  "compact": "Judge this exact candidate against applicable author, accepted-state, knowledge, Scene and due-obligation constraints. For evidence return a literal quote only; the host locates Unicode spans against the frozen candidate and rejects missing or ambiguous quotes. A quote alone is not semantic support. Separate conflicts, uncertainty, and taste; do not penalize omitted cost, growth, reversal, reward or hook techniques when they are not required by this Chapter. Never claim human approval. Check every prior diagnosis against revised prose and preserve successful content."
}
````

  "legacy": "Return only a bounded retrieval query proposal matching the strict schema. Every query must target one supplied deterministic evidence gap and stay within the frozen accepted chapter boundary and allowed selector dimensions.   "compact": "Return only a bounded retrieval query proposal matching the strict schema. Deterministic policy validates the proposal and alone decides whether another governed retrieval round executes."
}

{
  "legacy": "Diagnose the actual candidate against frozen constraints and creative guidance. Every issue requires category, judgment_kind, literal evidence with Unicode code-point start/end offsets, violated_constraint, revision_goal, preserve and acceptance_criteria. Separate semantic conflicts, uncertain judgments and aesthetic suggestions. Provider opinions are not deterministic proof; taste preferences alone are minor. Do not invent defects from a plan target that prose deliberately leaves unfulfilled. Return resolution_checks=[] on initial review. Evidence must identify a concrete defect and an observable repair condition. For every knowledge_review_target return a knowledge_check using its exact card version. Check mechanism, prerequisites, exceptions, cost and consequences in actual prose, including knowledge/disclosure boundaries, future leakage and false payoff. VERIFIED_IN_PROSE needs literal evidence and explicit conditions_checked/ exceptions_checked; terminology or Writer used_fact_ids is insufficient. Unused inspiration is NOT_USED, uncertainty is UNKNOWN. MISAPPLIED requires linked actionable issue_codes; unresolved CONSTRAINT requires a blocking issue. Return knowledge_checks=[] if no targets. Never call this formal proof or human approval.",
  "compact": "Judge this exact candidate against applicable author, accepted-state, knowledge, Scene and due-obligation constraints. For evidence return a literal quote only; the host locates Unicode spans against the frozen candidate and rejects missing or ambiguous quotes. A quote alone is not semantic support. Separate conflicts, uncertainty, and taste; do not penalize omitted cost, growth, reversal, reward or hook techniques when they are not required by this Chapter. Never claim human approval."
}

Resolve every supplied review issue in the prose, prioritizing blocking and major issues; list a code in resolved_issue_codes only after the edit is actually present. For a governed Quality revision task, make the smallest bounded edit that resolves the supplied task, preserve all unrelated scenes, causal links, established facts, and already-passing quality dimensions, and retain the complete reader-facing chapter at its original narrative scale unless chapter_length is itself the supplied task. Never replace the full chapter with a summary or excerpt. Preserve the reader-facing language of the input chapter and do not introduce unexplained code-switching. Preserve every unaffected Slot and the chapter's narrative scale. Address evidenced blocking issues; report a resolved code only when the revised prose actually addresses it. ````json
{
  "legacy": "Generate only bounded candidate world transitions from the supplied frozen Foundation, Intent and accepted Reality. Copy all Authority references exactly. ````python
def foundation_task(generator: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    role = FOUNDATION_GENERATORS[generator]
    tasks = {
        FoundationRole.CREATIVE_FOUNDATION: "Develop a distinctive, sustainable conflict from the brief. Explain reader value, choices and costs; create original operational style examples, never imitate reference prose.",
        FoundationRole.THEME_CONTRACT: "Turn the approved premise into opposing thematic answers tested by costly character decisions; avoid a moral slogan.",
        FoundationRole.ENDING_INTENT: "Design an earned ending direction with irreversible costs, required closures and forbidden shortcuts; this is future intent, not a predetermined accepted event.",
        FoundationRole.READER_PROMISE: "Specify what readers may expect, observable preparation, escalation and payoff; distinguish promise from fact and leave timing to Planning.",
        FoundationRole.WORLD_BIBLE: "Compile only world depth needed by the approved conflict. Consider laws, geography/time, resources, power, history/culture, existence and information; explain deferred dimensions and extension triggers. Rules need costs, exceptions and story consequences.",
        FoundationRole.CHARACTER_CAST: "Build a cast with distinct narrative functions, then deepen each through desire, fear, contradiction, beliefs and choices. Derive voice anchors from biography and motives. Ground relationships and capabilities in the approved world, never invent accepted history.",
    }
    return {
        "contract_version": "foundation-generation.v1",
        "role": role.value,
        "task": tasks[role],
        "parent_roles": [parent.value for parent in role.required_parents],
        "authority_boundary": "Generate a candidate only. Upstream versions are immutable. No Canon, knowledge or accepted-history writes. Independent diagnosis and activation follow.",
        **(
            {"world_contract": world_generation_contract()}
            if role is FoundationRole.WORLD_BIBLE
            else {}
        ),
        "repair_contract": "When repair evidence is present, address each unresolved diagnosis, preserve unaffected constraints and explain uncertainty through the candidate rather than silently replacing upstream decisions.",
    }
````

def foundation_output_schema(generator: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    role = FOUNDATION_GENERATORS[generator]
    properties: dict[str, Any] = {
        "objective": _text(),
        "constraints": _texts(),
        "prohibited_outcomes": _texts(),
    }
    if role is FoundationRole.CREATIVE_FOUNDATION:
        properties.update(
            {
                field: _text()
                for field in (
                    "target_reader why_worth_writing genre subgenre core_desire core_fear "
                    "core_conflict narrative_engine differentiation emotional_contract serialization_potential"
                ).split()
            }
        )
        properties["style_profile"] = _object(
            {
                "narrator": _text(),
                "pov": _text(),
                "genre_conventions": _texts(),
                "constraints": _texts(),
                "original_examples": _records("purpose example explanation", maximum=6),
            }
        )
    elif role is FoundationRole.THEME_CONTRACT:
        properties.update(
            {
                "thematic_question": _text(),
                "opposing_answers": _texts(),
                "choice_tests": _records("choice cost thematic_pressure"),
            }
        )
    elif role is FoundationRole.ENDING_INTENT:
        properties.update(
            {
                "ending_direction": _text(),
                "protagonist_cost": _text(),
                "closure_conditions": _texts(),
                "unacceptable_shortcuts": _texts(),
            }
        )
    elif role is FoundationRole.READER_PROMISE:
        properties.update(
            {
                "reader_promise": _text(),
                "setup_progress_payoff": _records("promise setup progress payoff"),
                "disappointment_risks": _texts(),
            }
        )
    elif role is FoundationRole.WORLD_BIBLE:
        properties.update(
            {
                "rules": _records("rule cost exception consequence narrative_function"),
                "world_foundation_json": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "minLength": 2,
                    "maxLength": 24000,
                    "description": "JSON encoded world-foundation.v1 object conforming to foundation_task.world_contract.schema. compiled_scope is exactly the frozen single string, never an array of enum choices. Decoded inner fields are strictly validated before candidate persistence.",
                },
                "dimensions": _records(
                    "dimension scope current_need definition constraints extension_trigger",
                    maximum=20,
                ),
                "factions": _records(
                    "faction_id goal resources pressure information_access", minimum=0
                ),
                "deferred_dimensions": _records("dimension reason trigger", minimum=0),
            }
        )
    else:
        character_fields = (
            "character_id name narrative_function desire need fear wound false_belief "
            "moral_boundary agency capability weakness voice private_history relationship_function arc_direction "
            "background contradiction behavioral_pattern risk_preference"
        )
        character = _object({field: _text() for field in character_fields.split()})
        character["properties"].update(
            {
                "aliases": _texts(),
                "pronouns": _texts(),
                "values": _texts(),
                "voice_anchors": _records("situation utterance motivation", maximum=4),
            }
        )
        character["required"] = list(character["properties"])
        properties["characters"] = {
            "type": "array",
            "items": character,
            "minItems": 1,
            "maxItems": 12,
        }
        properties["relationships"] = _records(
            "source_character_id target_character_id tension dependency change_pressure",
            minimum=0,
        )
    return {
        "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
        **_object(properties),
    }
````

def world_generation_contract(*, compiled_scope: str = "BOOK") -> dict[str, Any]:

                "value": "typed scalar; only EXISTS may omit value",
            },
            "mechanism": "Use MECHANISM only when the existing typed WorldMechanism contract can express the rule; otherwise request explicit design clarification. Do not replace a hard rule with soft reasoning.",
        },
        "entities": "nonempty array of unique entity_id and kind records; references must resolve; approved initial conditions are not accepted events",
    }

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/chapter_authority/prompt_methods.py:27` · project_sections

````python
def project_sections(text: str, *headings: str) -> str:
    sections: dict[str, str] = {}
    for part in ("\n" + text).split("\n## ")[1:]:
        heading, separator, body = part.partition("\n")
        if not separator or heading in sections:
            raise KernelError("PROMPT_METHOD_PROJECTION_INVALID", "frozen method headings must be distinct")
        sections[heading] = body.strip()
    if any(heading not in sections for heading in headings):
        raise KernelError("PROMPT_METHOD_PROJECTION_INVALID", "frozen artifact is missing its declared stage method")
    return "\n\n".join("## " + heading + "\n\n" + sections[heading] for heading in headings)
````

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/chapter_authority/prompt_methods.py:39` · project_skill_method

````python
def project_skill_method(text: str, *, ref: str, version: str, stage: str, targeted: bool) -> str:
    calibrated = version == _VERSIONS.get(ref) or (ref in _METHODS and version == ref + "-qualification-v2")
    if not calibrated:
        return text
    method = "Quality dimension" if ref == "quality-review" and stage.startswith("quality_") else _METHODS[ref].get(stage)
    if ref == "prose-generation" and stage == "revision" and targeted:
        method = "Targeted revision"
    if method is None:
        raise KernelError("PROMPT_METHOD_STAGE_UNSUPPORTED", "calibrated Skill has no method for the frozen stage")
    return project_sections(text, "Shared rules", method)
````

def project_planning_system(text: str, *, stage: str) -> str:
    methods = {
        "creative.candidates.generate": "Foundation", "theme.candidates.generate": "Foundation",
        "ending.intent.generate": "Foundation", "reader.promise.generate": "Foundation",
        "world.design.generate": "Foundation", "character.cast.generate": "Foundation",
        "book_plan.generate": "Book plan", "volume_plan.generate": "Volume plan",
        "arc_plan.generate": "Arc plan", "chapter_group_plan.generate": "Chapter group",
        "chapter_plan.generate": "Chapter plan", "world_candidates.generate": "World proposals", "world_candidates.evaluate": "World evaluation",
        **{f"world_candidates.actor_{index}": "Actor intention" for index in range(3)},
    }
    if stage not in methods:
        raise KernelError("PROMPT_METHOD_STAGE_UNSUPPORTED", "calibrated Planning System has no method for the frozen stage")
    headings = ["Shared rules", methods[stage]]
    if stage in {"world.design.generate", "character.cast.generate"} or stage.endswith("_plan.generate"):
        headings.append("Realization references")
    return project_sections(text, *headings)

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/chapter_quality_authority/domain.py:568` · _evaluate

````python
def _evaluate(
    *,
    group: str,
    dimension: str,
    project_id: str,
    target: str,
    metrics: dict[str, Any],
    segments: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...],
    context_bundle: dict[str, Any],
    canon: dict[str, Any],
    fixture: bool,
    profile_ids: dict[str, str],
    reference_calibration: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if dimension == "chapter_length":
        profile_id = profile_ids["platform_profile_version_id"]
        for segment in segments:
            if segment.get("asset_version_id") != profile_id:
                continue
            rules = compile_platform_policy(profile_asset_version_id=profile_id, segment=segment).chapter_length_rules
            if "unit" not in rules:
                break
            if rules["unit"] != "HAN_CHARACTERS_V1":
                raise KernelError("CHAPTER_LENGTH_UNIT_INVALID", "Unsupported explicit chapter length unit")
            minimum, maximum = rules.get("minimum"), rules.get("maximum")
            if type(minimum) is not int or type(maximum) is not int or not 0 < minimum <= maximum:
                raise KernelError("CHAPTER_LENGTH_POLICY_INVALID", "Frozen length bounds must be positive ordered integers")
            count = metrics["han_characters"]
            return _report(group, dimension, project_id, target,
                "PASSED" if minimum <= count <= maximum else "FAILED",
                score=None, calibration="DETERMINISTIC", source=profile_id,
                locations=[{"unit": rules["unit"], "observed": count, "minimum": minimum, "maximum": maximum}],
                fixture=fixture, profile_ids=profile_ids)
    calibrated = _calibrated_evidence(
        dimension, segments, target_asset_version_id=target, fixture=fixture, reference_calibration=reference_calibration
    )
    if calibrated is not None:
        status = str(calibrated.get("gate_status") or "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE").upper()
        if status not in QUALITY_EVIDENCE_STATUSES:
            raise KernelError(
                "QUALITY_EVIDENCE_STATUS_INVALID",
                f"invalid {dimension} evidence status",
            )
        waiver = None
        if status == "WAIVED_BY_APPROVAL":
            waiver = _approved_fixture_waiver(
                dimension,
                segments,
                project_id=project_id,
                target_asset_version_id=target,
            )
            if waiver is None:
                raise KernelError(
                    "QUALITY_FIXTURE_WAIVER_INVALID",
                    f"{dimension} waiver lacks a current scoped approval",
                )
        elif fixture and status == "PASSED_WITH_UNCALIBRATED":
            # WHY: A fixture Provider result remains non-production evidence.  It
            # may close an internal corrective loop only through the exact,
            # frozen operator waiver; a failed result is never converted.
            waiver = _approved_fixture_waiver(
                dimension,
                segments,
                project_id=project_id,
                target_asset_version_id=target,
            )
            if waiver is not None:
                status = "WAIVED_BY_APPROVAL"
        report = _report(
            group,
            dimension,
            project_id,
            target,
            status,
            score=calibrated.get("score"),
            calibration=str(calibrated["calibration_status"]),
            source=str(calibrated.get("evidence_source") or "authority_asset"),
            locations=list(calibrated.get("evidence_locations") or []),
            fixture=fixture,
            profile_ids=profile_ids,
            provider_verified=bool(calibrated.get("provider_verified")),
            human_verified=bool(calibrated.get("human_verified")),
        )
        if calibrated.get("reference_calibration"):
            report["reference_calibration"] = dict(calibrated["reference_calibration"])
        if waiver is not None:
            report["waiver"] = waiver
        return report

    source_clear = bool(
        context_bundle.get("source_isolation_result", {}).get("passed")
    ) and all(
        not segment.get("source_expression_included", True) for segment in segments
    )
    if dimension in {"source_leakage", "copyright_boundary"}:
        passed = (
            source_clear
            and context_bundle.get("copyright_boundary")
            == "abstract_or_project_owned_only"
        )
        return _report(
            group,
            dimension,
            project_id,
            target,
            "PASSED" if passed else "FAILED",
            score=None,
            calibration="DETERMINISTIC",
            source="context_source_isolation",
            locations=[
                {
                    "source_clear": source_clear,
                    "copyright_boundary": context_bundle.get("copyright_boundary"),
                }
            ],
            fixture=fixture,
            profile_ids=profile_ids,
        )
    if dimension == "readability":
        average = float(metrics["average_sentence"])
        score = round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 100.0 - max(0.0, average - 36.0) * 2.0)), 2)
        return _report(
            group,
            dimension,
            project_id,
            target,
            "PASSED" if score >= 70 else "FAILED",
            score=score,
            calibration="DETERMINISTIC",
            source="readability_metrics",
            locations=[{"average_sentence_length": average}],
            fixture=fixture,
            profile_ids=profile_ids,
        )
    if dimension in {"mobile_reading", "paragraph_structure"}:
        average = float(metrics["average_paragraph"])
        status = "PASSED" if average <= 270 else "FAILED"
        return _report(
            group,
            dimension,
            project_id,
            target,
            status,
            score=None,
            calibration="DETERMINISTIC",
            source="mobile_paragraph_metrics",
            locations=[{"average_paragraph_length": average}],
            fixture=fixture,
            profile_ids=profile_ids,
        )
    if dimension == "basic_prose_integrity":
        passed = metrics["sentences"] >= 2 and metrics["characters"] >= 80
        return _report(
            group,
            dimension,
            project_id,
            target,
            "PASSED" if passed else "FAILED",
            score=None,
            calibration="DETERMINISTIC",
            source="prose_integrity_metrics",
            locations=[metrics],
            fixture=fixture,
            profile_ids=profile_ids,
        )
    if dimension == "repetition":
        ratio = float(metrics["duplicate_sentence_ratio"])
        return _report(
            group,
            dimension,
            project_id,
            target,
            "PASSED" if ratio <= 0.25 else "FAILED",
            score=None,
            calibration="DETERMINISTIC",
            source="repetition_metrics",
            locations=[{"duplicate_sentence_ratio": ratio}],
            fixture=fixture,
            profile_ids=profile_ids,
        )
    if dimension == "canon_consistency":
        conflicts = list(canon.get("conflicts") or [])
        return _report(
            group,
            dimension,
            project_id,
            target,
            "PASSED" if not conflicts else "FAILED",
            score=None,
            calibration="DETERMINISTIC",
            source="canon_reduction",
            locations=[{"conflict_count": len(conflicts)}],
            fixture=fixture,
            profile_ids=profile_ids,
        )
    # WHY: Profile existence is deterministic; profile-specific compliance is not.
    if group == "platform" and not profile_ids["platform_profile_version_id"]:
        status = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
    elif group in {"commercial", "source_originality"}:
        status = "REQUIRES_PROVIDER_JUDGE"
    else:
        status = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
    return _report(
        group,
        dimension,
        project_id,
        target,
        status,
        score=None,
        calibration="FIXTURE_UNCALIBRATED" if fixture else "PROVIDER_UNCALIBRATED",
        source="none",
        locations=[],
        fixture=fixture,
        profile_ids=profile_ids,
    )
````

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/chapter_quality_authority/context_views.py:102` · compile_quality_policy

````python
def compile_quality_policy(
    *, profile_asset_version_id: str, segment: dict[str, Any]
) -> CompiledQualityPolicy:
    _require_profile_segment(profile_asset_version_id, segment, "quality")
    facts = _facts(segment)
    configured = dict(facts.get("thresholds") or facts.get("quality_thresholds") or {})
    defaults = {
        "readability": 70,
        "maximum_average_paragraph": 270,
        "maximum_duplicate_sentence_ratio": 0.25,
        "minimum_prose_characters": 80,
    }
    thresholds = {**defaults, **configured}
    digest = _digest({"source": profile_asset_version_id, "thresholds": thresholds})
    return CompiledQualityPolicy(
        source_asset_version_id=profile_asset_version_id,
        thresholds=thresholds,
        deterministic_policy_thresholds=tuple(
            key for key in defaults if key not in configured
        ),
        policy_digest=digest,
    )
````

def compile_platform_policy(
    *, profile_asset_version_id: str, segment: dict[str, Any]
) -> CompiledPlatformPolicy:
    _require_profile_segment(profile_asset_version_id, segment, "platform")
    facts = _facts(segment)
    rules = dict(facts.get("platform_rules") or facts.get("rules") or {})
    chapter_length = dict(
        rules.get("chapter_length") or facts.get("chapter_length_rules") or {}
    )
    if not chapter_length:
        chapter_length = {"status": "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"}
    return CompiledPlatformPolicy(
        source_asset_version_id=profile_asset_version_id,
        chapter_length_rules=chapter_length,
        format_rules=dict(rules.get("format") or facts.get("format_rules") or {}),
        sensitive_content_rules=tuple(
            rules.get("sensitive_content") or facts.get("sensitive_content_rules") or ()
        ),
        ai_content_policy=dict(
            rules.get("ai_content") or facts.get("ai_content_policy") or {}
        ),
        opening_expectations=tuple(
            rules.get("opening") or facts.get("opening_expectations") or ()
        ),
        rhythm_expectations=tuple(
            rules.get("rhythm") or facts.get("rhythm_expectations") or ()
        ),
        publish_metadata_rules=dict(
            rules.get("publish_metadata") or facts.get("publish_metadata_rules") or {}
        ),
        policy_digest=_digest({"source": profile_asset_version_id, "facts": facts}),
    )

def build_quality_context_view(
    *,
    group: str,
    revision: dict[str, Any],
    revision_asset_version_id: str,
    chapter_plan: dict[str, Any],
    chapter_plan_asset_version_id: str,
    context_bundle: dict[str, Any],
    context_bundle_asset_version_id: str,
    canon: dict[str, Any],
    canon_asset_version_id: str,
    token_budget: int = 6000,
    token_estimator: TokenEstimator | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if token_budget <= 0:
        raise KernelError(
            "QUALITY_CONTEXT_BUDGET_INVALID", "quality token budget must be positive"
        )
    estimator = token_estimator or ConservativeTokenEstimator()
    if group not in {
        "structural",
        "commercial",
        "source_originality",
        "longform",
        "platform",
    }:
        raise KernelError("QUALITY_GROUP_INVALID", "quality context group is invalid")
    manifest = dict(context_bundle.get("production_input_manifest") or {})
    quality_profile_id = str(manifest.get("quality_profile_version_id") or "")
    platform_profile_id = str(manifest.get("platform_profile_version_id") or "")
    segments = list(context_bundle.get("context_segments") or [])
    quality_policy = compile_quality_policy(
        profile_asset_version_id=quality_profile_id,
        segment=_segment_by_version(segments, quality_profile_id),
    )
    platform_policy = compile_platform_policy(
        profile_asset_version_id=platform_profile_id,
        segment=_segment_by_version(segments, platform_profile_id),
    )
    common = {
        "project_id": str(context_bundle.get("project_id") or ""),
        "target_revision_asset_version_id": revision_asset_version_id,
        "chapter_plan_asset_version_id": chapter_plan_asset_version_id,
        "context_bundle_asset_version_id": context_bundle_asset_version_id,
        "quality_profile_version_id": quality_profile_id,
        "platform_profile_version_id": platform_profile_id,
        "compiled_quality_policy": asdict(quality_policy),
    }
    if group == "structural":
        body = {
            "type": "StructuralQualityContextView",
            **common,
            "revision_text": str(revision.get("text") or ""),
            "target_word_count": chapter_plan.get("target_word_count"),
            "paragraph_policy": quality_policy.thresholds,
            "dialogue_narration_policy": chapter_plan.get("style_constraints", {}),
            "readability_policy": quality_policy.thresholds,
            "mobile_reading_policy": quality_policy.thresholds,
            "format_policy": platform_policy.format_rules,
            "chapter_intent": chapter_plan.get("chapter_intent"),
            "scene_plan": chapter_plan.get("scene_plan", []),
        }
    elif group == "commercial":
        body = {
            "type": "CommercialQualityContextView",
            **common,
            "revision_text": str(revision.get("text") or ""),
            "chapter_function": chapter_plan.get("chapter_function"),
            "chapter_objective": chapter_plan.get("chapter_objective"),
            "reader_promise_actions": chapter_plan.get("reader_promise_actions", []),
            "reward_setup": chapter_plan.get("reward_setup", []),
            "reward_payoff": chapter_plan.get("reward_payoff", []),
            "protagonist_charm_mechanism": chapter_plan.get(
                "protagonist_charm_mechanism"
            ),
            "antagonist_pressure": chapter_plan.get("antagonist_pressure"),
            "suspense_curve": chapter_plan.get("suspense_curve", []),
            "emotional_curve": chapter_plan.get("emotional_curve", []),
            "chapter_hook": chapter_plan.get("chapter_hook"),
            "serialization_function": chapter_plan.get("serialization_function"),
            "opening_state": chapter_plan.get("opening_state"),
            "next_chapter_bridge": chapter_plan.get("next_chapter_bridge"),
            "chapter_intent": chapter_plan.get("chapter_intent"),
            "arc_schedule": chapter_plan.get("arc_schedule", []),
            "setups": chapter_plan.get("setups", []),
            "payoffs": chapter_plan.get("payoffs", []),
            "reader_experience": chapter_plan.get("reader_experience", {}),
        }
    elif group == "source_originality":
        governed_segments = [
            {
                "asset_version_id": item.get("asset_version_id"),
                "asset_type": item.get("asset_type"),
                "content_digest": item.get("content_digest"),

        ]
        if any(item.get("source_expression_included") for item in governed_segments):
            raise KernelError(
                "QUALITY_SOURCE_CONTEXT_LEAK",
                "Source quality context may not contain source expression",
            )
        body = {
            "type": "SourceOriginalityQualityContextView",
            **common,
            "revision_text": str(revision.get("text") or ""),
            "source_governance": manifest.get("source_governance", {}),
            # WHY: Quality consumes a provenance projection, not a second copy of
            # the full Context Manifest (which remains persisted on the
            # ContextBundle).  This keeps source evidence exact without
            # spending the quality budget on duplicated retrieval traces.
            "context_manifest": _source_context_manifest_view(
                dict(context_bundle.get("context_manifest") or {})
            ),
            "source_isolation_result": context_bundle.get(
                "source_isolation_result", {}
            ),
            "copyright_boundary": context_bundle.get("copyright_boundary"),
            "governed_segment_identities": governed_segments,
            "source_expression_excluded": True,
        }
    elif group == "longform":
        previous_states = _group_state_segments(segments)
        candidates = dict(canon.get("state_changes") or {})
        if (chapter_plan.get("constraint_envelope") or {}).get(
            "world_preparation", {}
        ).get("action", {}).get("contract_version") == "world-production-action.v2":
            from novel_forge.modules.narrative_state.information import (
                disclosed_fact_projection,
            )

            candidates = {
                kind: [
                    disclosed_fact_projection({"state": item})["state"]
                    for item in changes
                    if (item.get("fact_origin") or {}).get("kind")
                    not in {"GOVERNED_BACKGROUND", "GOVERNED_PREPARATION"}
                ]
                for kind, changes in candidates.items()
            }
            candidates = {
                kind: changes for kind, changes in candidates.items() if changes
            }
        current_states = _group_current_state_candidates(candidates)
        body = {
            "type": "LongformQualityContextView",
            **common,
            "revision_text": str(revision.get("text") or ""),
            "canon_patch_asset_version_id": canon_asset_version_id,
            "canon_conflicts": _project_canon_conflicts(
                list(canon.get("conflicts") or [])
            ),
            "previous_state_snapshots": previous_states,
            "current_state_candidates": current_states,
            "governed_world_rules": _segments_of_type(segments, "world_bible"),
            "volume_arc": _segments_of_type(segments, "volume_arc"),
            "arc_progress": _segments_of_type(segments, "arc_progress_report"),
            "previous_recap": _segments_of_type(segments, "longform_recap_report"),
            "chapter_plan": _longform_chapter_plan_view(chapter_plan),
            "canon_change_proposal_asset_version_id": canon.get(
                "canon_change_proposal_asset_version_id", ""
            ),
        }
    else:
        source_extensions = chapter_plan.get("source_extensions")
        summary = (
            chapter_plan.get("safe_summary")
            or (
                source_extensions.get("safe_summary")
                if isinstance(source_extensions, dict)
                else ""
            )
            or chapter_plan.get("premise")
            or ""
        )
        body = {
            "type": "PlatformQualityContextView",
            **common,
            "revision_text": str(revision.get("text") or ""),
            "compiled_platform_policy": asdict(platform_policy),
            "publish_metadata_candidate": {
                "chapter": revision.get("chapter"),
                "title": str(revision.get("title") or chapter_plan.get("title") or ""),
                "summary": str(summary),
            },
        }
    body["token_budget"] = token_budget
    coverage = _fit_quality_context(
        body,
        estimator=estimator,
        token_budget=token_budget,
    )
    body["coverage_report"] = coverage
    body["contract_version"] = "stage-quality-context-v4"
    body["context_digest"] = _digest(body)
    final_tokens = _estimate_payload(body, estimator)
    if final_tokens > token_budget:
        raise KernelError(
            "QUALITY_CONTEXT_CRITICAL_OVERFLOW",
            "quality context identity and critical evidence exceed the frozen token budget",
        )
    body["coverage_report"]["token_estimate"] = final_tokens
    return body

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/chapter_quality_authority/context_views.py:708` · _fit_quality_context

````python
def _fit_quality_context(
    body: dict[str, Any], *, estimator: TokenEstimator, token_budget: int
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows = list(_state_rows(body))
    report_reserve = min(512, max(128, token_budget // 8))
    content_budget = max(1, token_budget - report_reserve)
    while _estimate_payload(body, estimator) > content_budget:
        if not _compress_one_noncritical_fact(body, rows):
            raise KernelError(
                "QUALITY_CONTEXT_CRITICAL_OVERFLOW",
                "quality context identity and critical evidence exceed the frozen token budget",
            )
        rows = list(_state_rows(body))

    # WHY: The coverage report is variable-sized because entity coverage is explicit.
    # A fixed reserve can therefore fit the evidence body yet overflow once the
    # report, contract version, and digest are serialized. Re-evaluate the actual
    # final envelope and only remove additional noncritical facts. Identity rows,
    # AssetVersion lineage, and critical facts remain fail-closed.
    while True:
        coverage = _quality_context_coverage_report(
            body,
            rows=rows,
            estimator=estimator,
            token_budget=token_budget,
        )
        if _estimate_final_quality_context(body, coverage, estimator) <= token_budget:
            return coverage
        if not _compress_one_noncritical_fact(body, rows):
            raise KernelError(
                "QUALITY_CONTEXT_CRITICAL_OVERFLOW",
                "quality context identity and critical evidence exceed the frozen token budget",
            )
        rows = list(_state_rows(body))
````

def qualification_profile_for_plan(content: dict[str, Any]) -> ChapterPlanQualificationProfile:
    chapter = int(content.get("chapter") or 0)
    function = str(content.get("chapter_function") or "ordinary").strip().lower()
    phase = str(content.get("book_phase") or ("opening" if chapter == 1 else "ordinary")).lower()
    if chapter == 1 or function in {"opening", "golden_opening"}:
        required = BASE_REQUIRED_FIELDS + (
            "conflict_chain", "reader_promise_actions", "protagonist_charm_mechanism",
            "information_reveals", "next_chapter_bridge",
        )
        profile_id = "chapter-plan-v3:opening"
    elif function in {"payoff", "reward_payoff", "pleasure_payoff"}:
        required = BASE_REQUIRED_FIELDS + (
            "reward_setup", "reward_payoff", "conflict_escalation",
            "reader_promise_actions", "next_chapter_bridge",
        )
        profile_id = "chapter-plan-v3:payoff"
    elif function in {"climax", "volume_climax", "ending"} or phase in {"climax", "ending"}:
        required = BASE_REQUIRED_FIELDS + (
            "reward_payoff", "antagonist_pressure", "canon_expected_changes",
            "closing_state", "next_chapter_bridge",
        )
        profile_id = "chapter-plan-v3:climax"
    else:
        required = BASE_REQUIRED_FIELDS + (
            "conflict_chain", "emotional_curve", "suspense_curve",
            "reader_promise_actions", "antagonist_pressure", "next_chapter_bridge",
        )
        profile_id = "chapter-plan-v3:ordinary"
    warnings = tuple(field for field in PLAN_FIELDS if field not in required)
    return ChapterPlanQualificationProfile(
        profile_id=profile_id,
        required_fields=required,
        warning_fields=warnings,
        genre=str(content.get("genre") or "any"),
        platform=str(content.get("platform") or "any"),
        book_phase=phase,
        chapter_function=function,
    )
````

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/chapter_authority/chapter_plan_views.py:126` · normalize_authoritative_chapter_plan

````python
def normalize_authoritative_chapter_plan(
    *,
    project_id: str,
    expected_chapter: int,
    content: dict[str, Any],
    asset_version_id: str,
    content_hash: str,
    qualification_profile: ChapterPlanQualificationProfile | None = None,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ChapterPlanQualificationReport]:
    declared_project = str(content.get("project_id") or project_id)
    if declared_project != project_id:
        raise KernelError("CHAPTER_PLAN_CROSS_PROJECT", "ChapterPlan project does not match Operation")
    try:
        chapter = int(content.get("chapter"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise KernelError("CHAPTER_PLAN_CHAPTER_INVALID", "ChapterPlan chapter is missing") from exc
    if chapter != expected_chapter:
        raise KernelError("CHAPTER_PLAN_CHAPTER_MISMATCH", "ChapterPlan targets another chapter")
    if content.get("chapter_contract_schema_version"):
        from novel_forge.modules.hierarchical_planning.chapter_contracts import (
            require_chapter_contracts,
        )

        require_chapter_contracts(content)

    mappings: dict[str, str] = {}
    objective = content.get("chapter_objective")
    if not objective and content.get("objective"):
        objective = content["objective"]
        mappings["objective"] = "chapter_objective"
    scenes = content.get("scene_sequence")
    if not scenes and content.get("scenes"):
        scenes = content["scenes"]
        mappings["scenes"] = "scene_sequence"
    if not scenes and content.get("beats"):
        scenes = content["beats"]
        mappings["beats"] = "scene_sequence"
    hook = content.get("chapter_hook")
    if not hook and content.get("closing_hook"):
        hook = content["closing_hook"]
        mappings["closing_hook"] = "chapter_hook"

    normalized: dict[str, Any] = {
        "type": "AuthoritativeChapterPlan",
        "project_id": project_id,
        "chapter": chapter,
        "title": str(content.get("title") or "").strip(),
        "premise": str(content.get("premise") or "").strip(),
        "chapter_objective": str(objective or "").strip(),
        "scene_sequence": list(scenes) if isinstance(scenes, (list, tuple)) else [],
        "chapter_hook": str(hook or "").strip(),
        "source_chapter_plan_asset_version_id": asset_version_id,
        "source_chapter_plan_content_hash": content_hash,
        "source_schema_version": str(content.get("schema_version") or content.get("contract_version") or "legacy"),
        "contract_version": "authoritative-chapter-plan-v4",
    }
    for field in PLAN_FIELDS:
        if field in {"chapter_objective", "scene_sequence", "chapter_hook"}:
            continue
        value = content.get(field)
        normalized[field] = list(value) if field in LIST_FIELDS and isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else (
            [] if field in LIST_FIELDS else value
        )
    normalized.update({key: content[key] for key in KNOWLEDGE_PLAN_FIELDS if key in content})
    known = {"project_id", "chapter", "title", "premise", "objective", "beats", "scenes", "closing_hook", "schema_version", "contract_version", *PLAN_FIELDS, *KNOWLEDGE_PLAN_FIELDS}
    normalized["source_extensions"] = {
        key: value for key, value in content.items() if key not in known
    }
    profile = qualification_profile or LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_PROFILE
    blocking = tuple(field for field in profile.required_fields if not normalized.get(field))
    warnings = tuple(
        field for field in profile.warning_fields
        if not normalized.get(field) and field not in blocking
    )
    digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    ).hexdigest()
    report = ChapterPlanQualificationReport(
        decision="BLOCKED" if blocking else "ELIGIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS" if warnings else "ELIGIBLE",
        blocking_missing_fields=blocking,
        warning_missing_fields=warnings,
        compatibility_mappings=mappings,
        input_asset_version_id=asset_version_id,
        input_content_hash=content_hash,
        normalized_digest=digest,
        qualification_profile_id=profile.profile_id,
        source_schema_version=normalized["source_schema_version"],
    )
    if blocking:
        raise KernelError(
            "CHAPTER_PLAN_SEMANTIC_FIELDS_MISSING",
            "ChapterPlan is missing blocking semantic fields: " + ", ".join(blocking),
        )
    normalized["qualification"] = json.loads(json.dumps(asdict(report), sort_keys=True))
    normalized["normalized_digest"] = digest
    return json.loads(json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True)), report
````

def build_draft_plan_view(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:

            "canon_expected_changes", "world_rule_usages", "power_state_changes",

            "quality_targets",
            "protagonist_charm_mechanism", "serialization_function",
            "chapter_economy_function", "reader_dropoff_risks", "payoff_schedule",
            "platform_rhythm", "conflict_escalation",
            "constraint_envelope",
            "narrative_architecture_version", "narrative_segment_ref",
            "chapter_intent", "arc_schedule", "setups", "payoffs",
            "character_participation", "knowledge_boundaries", "disclosures",

            "expected_exit_state", "narrative_realization_slice",
            "chapter_contract_schema_version", "primary_function", "obligation_actions",
            "required_arc_contributions",
        )},
        "source_chapter_plan_asset_version_id": plan["source_chapter_plan_asset_version_id"],
        "source_chapter_plan_content_hash": plan["source_chapter_plan_content_hash"],
        **{key: plan[key] for key in KNOWLEDGE_PLAN_FIELDS if key in plan},
    }
    result = without_author_private(result)
    binding = (plan.get("constraint_envelope") or {}).get("author_design")
    if binding:
        result["author_design_guidance"] = project_author_design(binding, target="CHAPTER", chapter=int(plan["chapter"]))
    return result

    def _materialization(self, spec: _ExecutionSpec) -> dict[str, Any]:
        system_text = (
            "You analyze governed source evidence for reusable abstract mechanisms. "
            "Never reproduce protected expression or treat an Observation as reusable "
            "knowledge before MKAOS governance."
        )
        skill_text = spec.methodology_content
        actual_skill_hash = (
            "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(skill_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        )
        if actual_skill_hash != spec.methodology_content_hash:
            raise KernelError(
                "SOURCE_SKILL_MATERIALIZATION_DRIFT",
                "frozen Skill bytes differ from Analyzer methodology digest",
            )
        template_text = (
            "Perform the frozen Source intelligence stage and return a bounded JSON "
            "object matching the supplied schema."
        )
        output_ref = (
            default_capability_registry().resolve(spec.capability).output_schema_ref
        )
        materialization: dict[str, Any] = {
            "schema_version": "source-capability-materialization.v1",
            "stage": spec.stage,
            "capability": spec.capability,
            "system_instruction": {
                "ref": "source-intelligence-system",
                "version": "1.0",
                "content_hash": _hash(system_text),
                "text": system_text,
            },
            "prompt_template": {
                "ref": spec.prompt_id,
                "version": spec.prompt_version,
                "content_hash": _hash(template_text),
                "text": template_text,
            },
            "skill": {
                "ref": spec.skill_id,
                "version": spec.skill_version,
                "content_hash": spec.methodology_content_hash,
                "text": skill_text,
            },
            "tool_permissions": {
                "default": "DENY",
                "allowed": ["model.provider.invoke"],
                "denied": ["shell", "filesystem", "web", "mcp"],
            },
            "output_schema": {
                "ref": output_ref,
                "content_hash": _hash(spec.output_schema),
                "content": spec.output_schema,
            },
            "source_isolation": {
                "raw_source_persisted_in_postgresql": False,
                "raw_source_allowed_in_generation_context": False,
                "provider_input_resolved_from_object_store": True,
            },
        }
        materialization["materialization_hash"] = _hash(materialization)
        return materialization

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/story_design_authority/qualification.py:432` · validate_narrative_qualification

````python
def validate_narrative_qualification(
    *,
    generator_operation_name: str,
    value: Any,
    require_pass: bool = True,
) -> NarrativeQualificationResult:
    profiles = required_qualification_profiles(generator_operation_name)
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or (
        value.get("schema_version") != NARRATIVE_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION
    ):
        raise KernelError(
            "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_REQUIRED",
            "candidate requires a versioned Narrative Semantic Evaluation",
        )
    evaluations = value.get("evaluations")
    if not isinstance(evaluations, list):
        raise KernelError(
            "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
            "Narrative Semantic Evaluation entries must be an array",
        )
    by_layer: dict[NarrativeDesignLayer, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
    for item in evaluations:
        if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
            raise KernelError(
                "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                "Narrative Semantic Evaluation entries must be objects",
            )
        try:
            layer = NarrativeDesignLayer(str(item.get("layer") or ""))
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise KernelError(
                "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                "Narrative Semantic Evaluation uses an unknown design layer",
            ) from exc
        if layer in by_layer:
            raise KernelError(
                "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                "Narrative Semantic Evaluation repeats one design layer",
            )
        by_layer[layer] = item
    expected_layers = {profile.layer for profile in profiles}
    if set(by_layer) != expected_layers:
        raise KernelError(
            "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
            "Narrative Semantic Evaluation layers differ from the stage profile",
        )

    receipts: list[NarrativeQualificationReceipt] = []
    failures: list[str] = []
    for profile in profiles:
        evaluation = by_layer[profile.layer]
        profile_verdicts: list[str] = []
        identity = (
            str(evaluation.get("profile_id") or ""),
            str(evaluation.get("profile_version") or ""),
            str(evaluation.get("profile_hash") or ""),
            str(evaluation.get("capability_id") or ""),
            str(evaluation.get("skill_ref") or ""),
        )
        expected_identity = (
            profile.profile_id,
            profile.profile_version,
            profile.profile_hash,
            profile.capability_id,
            profile.skill_ref,
        )
        if identity != expected_identity:
            raise KernelError(
                "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_PROFILE_DRIFT",
                f"{profile.layer.value} evaluation differs from its frozen profile",
            )
        criteria = evaluation.get("criteria")
        if not isinstance(criteria, list):
            raise KernelError(
                "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                f"{profile.layer.value} evaluation criteria must be an array",
            )
        by_criterion: dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
        for criterion in criteria:
            if not isinstance(criterion, Mapping):
                raise KernelError(
                    "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                    "Narrative criterion must be an object",
                )
            criterion_id = str(criterion.get("criterion") or "")
            if not criterion_id or criterion_id in by_criterion:
                raise KernelError(
                    "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                    "Narrative criteria require unique identities",
                )
            by_criterion[criterion_id] = criterion
        if set(by_criterion) != set(profile.criteria):
            raise KernelError(
                "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                f"{profile.layer.value} evaluation criteria differ from the profile",
            )
        for criterion_id in profile.criteria:
            criterion = by_criterion[criterion_id]
            verdict = str(criterion.get("verdict") or "")
            rationale = str(criterion.get("rationale") or "").strip()
            evidence_refs = criterion.get("evidence_refs")
            repair = str(criterion.get("repair_directive") or "").strip()
            if (
                verdict not in {"PASS", "FAIL", "INSUFFICIENT"}
                or not rationale
                or not isinstance(evidence_refs, list)
                or not evidence_refs
                or any(not str(ref).strip() for ref in evidence_refs)
                or (verdict != "PASS" and not repair)
                or (verdict == "PASS" and repair)
            ):
                raise KernelError(
                    "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_EVALUATION_INVALID",
                    f"{profile.layer.value}/{criterion_id} verdict evidence is invalid",
                )
            if verdict != "PASS":
                failures.append(f"{profile.layer.value}:{criterion_id}:{verdict}")
            profile_verdicts.append(verdict)
        evaluation_dict = dict(evaluation)
        profile_status = (
            "FAIL"
            if "FAIL" in profile_verdicts
            else "INSUFFICIENT"
            if "INSUFFICIENT" in profile_verdicts
            else "PASS"
        )
        receipts.append(
            NarrativeQualificationReceipt(
                layer=profile.layer,
                status=profile_status,
                profile_id=profile.profile_id,
                profile_version=profile.profile_version,
                profile_hash=profile.profile_hash,
                capability_id=profile.capability_id,
                skill_ref=profile.skill_ref,
                criterion_count=len(profile.criteria),
                evaluation_hash=_canonical_hash(evaluation_dict),
                evidence=evaluation_dict,
            )
        )
    if failures and require_pass:
        raise KernelError(
            "NARRATIVE_SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION_FAILED",
            ", ".join(failures),
        )
    status = (
        "FAIL"
        if any(receipt.status == "FAIL" for receipt in receipts)
        else "INSUFFICIENT"
        if any(receipt.status == "INSUFFICIENT" for receipt in receipts)
        else "PASS"
    )
    evidence = {
        "schema_version": NARRATIVE_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "generator_operation_name": generator_operation_name,
        "status": status,
        "receipts": [
            {
                "layer": receipt.layer.value,
                "status": receipt.status,
                "profile_hash": receipt.profile_hash,
                "evaluation_hash": receipt.evaluation_hash,
            }
            for receipt in receipts
        ],
    }
    return NarrativeQualificationResult(
        status=status,
        schema_version=NARRATIVE_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        qualification_hash=_canonical_hash(evidence),
        receipts=tuple(receipts),
    )
````

def qualification_provider_schema(generator_operation_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    profiles = required_qualification_profiles(generator_operation_name)
    string = {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}
    criterion = _strict_object(
        {
            "criterion": string,
            "verdict": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": ["PASS", "FAIL", "INSUFFICIENT"],
            },
            "rationale": string,
            "evidence_refs": {
                "type": "array",
                "minItems": 1,
                "items": string,
            },
            "repair_directive": {"type": "string"},
        }
    )
    evaluation = _strict_object(
        {
            "layer": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [profile.layer.value for profile in profiles],
            },
            "profile_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [profile.profile_id for profile in profiles],
            },
            "profile_version": {"type": "string", "const": "1.0.0"},
            "profile_hash": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [profile.profile_hash for profile in profiles],
            },
            "capability_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [profile.capability_id for profile in profiles],
            },
            "skill_ref": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [profile.skill_ref for profile in profiles],
            },
            "criteria": {
                "type": "array",
                "minItems": min(len(profile.criteria) for profile in profiles),
                "maxItems": max(len(profile.criteria) for profile in profiles),
                "items": criterion,
            },
        }
    )
    return {
        "$schema": PROVIDER_JSON_SCHEMA_DIALECT,
        **_strict_object(
            {
                "schema_version": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "const": NARRATIVE_QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
                },
                "evaluations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": len(profiles),
                    "maxItems": len(profiles),
                    "items": evaluation,
                },
            }
        ),
    }
````

````python
def _select_capability_skill(
    skills: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    *,
    capability_id: str,
    input_contract_ref: str,
    output_contract_ref: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """INVARIANT: Select a Skill from the Pack without requiring an Agent Definition.

    Exact input/output contract matches win.  Packs whose Skill contract is
    intentionally broader may fall back to a single required Skill; multiple
    ambiguous fallbacks fail closed instead of depending on list order.
    """
    exact = [
        dict(item)
        for item in skills
        if str(item.get("input_contract_ref") or "") == input_contract_ref
        and str(item.get("output_contract_ref") or "") == output_contract_ref
    ]
    if len(exact) == 1:
        return exact[0]
    output_matches = [
        dict(item)
        for item in skills
        if str(item.get("output_contract_ref") or "") == output_contract_ref
    ]
    if len(output_matches) == 1:
        return output_matches[0]
    foundation_skills = {
        "creative.proposal.generate": "topic-development",
        "theme.question.generate": "narrative-beat-design",
        "ending.intent.generate": "long-outline",
        "reader.promise.generate": "hot-novel-business-deconstruction",
        "world.design.generate": "worldbuilding",
        "character.cast.generate": "character-design",
    }
    preferred_skill = (
        foundation_skills[capability_id]
        if capability_id in foundation_skills
        else "chapter-outline"
        if capability_id.startswith("planning.")
        else "context-builder-source-isolation"
        if capability_id.startswith("retrieval.") or capability_id == "context.task.compile"
        else "prose-generation"
        if capability_id.startswith(("prose.", "revision."))
        else "canon-continuity-graph"
        if capability_id.startswith("canon.")
        else "quality-review"
        if capability_id.startswith(("review.", "quality.", "publishing.", "storage."))
        else ""
    )
    calibrated = {str(item.get("skill_ref")): str(item.get("version")) for item in skills}
    if capability_id == "reader.promise.generate" and calibrated.get("topic-development") == "topic-development-qualification-v2":
        preferred_skill = "topic-development"
    if capability_id in {"planning.book.generate", "planning.volume.generate", "planning.arc.generate", "planning.chapter_group.generate"} and calibrated.get("long-outline") == "long-outline-v2":
        preferred_skill = "long-outline"
    preferred = [
        dict(item)
        for item in skills
        if str(item.get("skill_ref") or "") == preferred_skill
    ]
    if len(preferred) == 1:
        return preferred[0]
    required = [dict(item) for item in skills if bool(item.get("required"))]
    if len(required) == 1:
        return required[0]
    raise KernelError(
        "CAPABILITY_PACK_SKILL_BINDING_AMBIGUOUS",
        "Capability node requires one contract-matching Skill binding",
    )
````

````python
def deepseek_strict_tools(output_schema_json: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    schema = json.loads(output_schema_json)
    if not isinstance(schema, dict) or schema.get("type") != "object":
        raise ValueError("DEEPSEEK_STRICT_ROOT_OBJECT_REQUIRED")

    def project(node: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not isinstance(node, dict):
            raise ValueError("DEEPSEEK_STRICT_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED")
        native_only = {
            "minLength",
            "maxLength",
            "minItems",
            "maxItems",
            "$schema",
            "title",
        }
        supported = {
            "type",
            "properties",
            "required",
            "additionalProperties",
            "items",
            "enum",
            "description",
        }
        if set(node) - native_only - supported:
            raise ValueError("DEEPSEEK_STRICT_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED")
        kind = node.get("type")
        if kind not in {"object", "array", "string", "number", "integer", "boolean"}:
            raise ValueError("DEEPSEEK_STRICT_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED")
        result = {k: v for k, v in node.items() if k in supported}
        if kind == "object":
            properties = node.get("properties")
            if (
                not isinstance(properties, dict)
                or set(node.get("required") or []) != set(properties)
                or node.get("additionalProperties") is not False
            ):
                raise ValueError("DEEPSEEK_STRICT_CLOSED_REQUIRED_OBJECT_ONLY")
            result["properties"] = {k: project(v) for k, v in properties.items()}
        elif kind == "array":
            result["items"] = project(node.get("items"))
        return result

    return [
        {
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
                "name": DEEPSEEK_OUTPUT_TOOL,
                "description": "Submit the complete task result once. All frozen business constraints still apply.",
                "strict": True,
                "parameters": project(schema),
            },
        }
    ]
````

### B · `src/novel_forge/modules/chapter_authority/execution_gateway.py:3684` · _language_semantic_contract

````python
def _language_semantic_contract(required_language: str | None) -> str:
    if not required_language:
        return ""
    if required_language != "zh-CN":
        raise KernelError(
            "CHAPTER_LANGUAGE_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED",
            f"unsupported governed reader-facing language: {required_language}",
        )
    return (
        "The governed reader-facing language is zh-CN. Write reader-facing titles, "
        "synopses, chapter prose, revision prose, and explanatory review evidence "
        "primarily in Simplified Chinese. Keep schema keys and stable identifiers "
        "unchanged, and do not translate identifiers."
    )
````

def _stage_semantic_contract(
    stage: str,
    *,
    required_language: str | None = None,
    embedding_output_contract: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> str:
    if stage == "retrieval":
        if embedding_output_contract is None:
            return (
                "Return exactly one numeric embedding vector for each frozen input "
                "text, in the same order. Return the actual embedding model identity "
                "and vector dimensions. Do not add facts, summarize, retrieve, or "
                "mutate Authority state."
            )
        expected_model = str(embedding_output_contract.get("embedding_model") or "")
        try:
            expected_dimensions = int(
                embedding_output_contract.get("embedding_dimensions") or 0
            )
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise KernelError(
                "RETRIEVAL_EMBEDDING_OUTPUT_CONTRACT_INVALID",
                "frozen retrieval embedding dimensions are invalid",
            ) from exc
        if (
            not expected_model
            or not 1 <= expected_dimensions <= 8192
            or embedding_output_contract.get("vector_normalization") != "L2_UNIT"
            or embedding_output_contract.get("placeholder_vectors_allowed") is not False
        ):
            raise KernelError(
                "RETRIEVAL_EMBEDDING_OUTPUT_CONTRACT_INVALID",
                "frozen retrieval embedding model, dimensions, or vector policy is invalid",
            )
        return (
            "Return exactly one numeric embedding vector for each frozen input text, "
            "in the same order. The frozen output identity is exact: set embedding_model "
            f"to {_canonical(expected_model)} and embedding_dimensions to "
            f"{expected_dimensions}. Every vector must have exactly "
            f"{expected_dimensions} finite numeric entries and non-zero L2 norm; normalize "
            "each vector to unit length. Produce a genuine dense semantic representation "
            "whose latent axes remain consistent across calls under this exact contract, "
            "so meaningfully similar passages remain close without lexical, entity, Arc, "
            "or obligation overlap. Never emit a placeholder, sentinel, all-zero vector, "
            "provider-unavailable identity, summary, or invented fact. Do not retrieve or "
            "mutate Authority state."
        )
    if stage == "context_compress":
        return (
            "Select exact unit_id values from this bounded chunk that retain the task relevant "
            "causal meaning. Preserve every required unit and the subject, time, negation, "
            "condition, exception, uncertainty, and distinction between fact, belief, suspicion "
            "and plan. Keep task important voice, humor, relationship subtext and promise wording. "
            "Return unit IDs only; do not rewrite text, invent units, emit source hashes or "
            "positions, or decide fidelity. This is a derived extract proposal, never Canon. "
            "If required information cannot fit, preserve it and let the host block. "
        )
    if stage == "context_fidelity":
        return (
            "Independently inspect the proposed extract against this original source chunk "
            "and frozen task. Check forward source support and reverse required meaning coverage. "
            "Check subject, time, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, epistemic "
            "status, causal prerequisites, voice, relationship subtext and promises. A legal ID "
            "alone is not fidelity proof. Report unsupported or distorted selected IDs and "
            "missing original IDs. Fail closed on uncertainty and give a concrete reason. "
            "Do not rewrite extracts, mutate story state or rely on a compressor verdict. "
        )
    if stage == "retrieval_query_expansion":
        return (
            "Return only a bounded retrieval query proposal matching the strict schema. "
            "Every query must target one supplied deterministic evidence gap and stay "
            "within the frozen accepted chapter boundary and allowed selector dimensions. "
            "Never emit SQL, database identifiers, arbitrary AssetVersion identifiers, "
            "future-state selectors, retrieved records, sufficiency decisions, or Authority "
            "mutations. Deterministic policy validates the proposal and alone decides whether "
            "another governed retrieval round executes."
        )
    if stage == "agent_session":
        return (
            "Reason only over the frozen accepted boundary, committed transcript, "
            "observations, and server Tool snapshot. Choose exactly one action: "
            "request one Tool by copying its exact tool_name, or return one final "
            "candidate/proposal response. Encode Tool arguments and final response as one JSON "
            "object string in the required payload_json envelope. The outer response "
            "must still match the strict schema exactly. A Skill supplies method only and never "
            "adds permission. Never claim to mutate Canon, Accepted Narrative State, "
            "Arc Actual, Narrative Obligation lifecycle, active Plan pointers, or "
            "Chapter acceptance. Authority Commands submit proposals only; the owning "
            "Authority decides them."
        )
    realization_instruction = (
        (
            "Produce candidate prose within the frozen Scene realization contract. "
            "Each selected specialist slot must appear exactly once in contract order. "
            "Use only its accessible fact references; report used_fact_ids explicitly. "
            "Do not give a character reader-only knowledge. Keep every factual commitment "
            "inside the approved Scene scope and declared voice contracts. The text field "
            "must equal slot texts joined with two newlines, or the exact frozen scene_separators "
            "when supplied for an author candidate. Preserve those separators. For Revision, preserve unaffected "
            "slots and amend only slots needed by the frozen review issues; Quality and Actual "
            "reconciliation will run again. If no Scene slots exist, return scene_artifacts=[]. "
            "Candidate generation never changes Canon or accepted Narrative Reality."
        )
        if stage in {"draft", "revision"}
        else ""
    )
    if stage == "narrative_semantic_evaluation":
        return (
            "Independently evaluate the immutable candidate against every frozen "
            "qualification profile and criterion. The frozen Provider Context is the "
            "complete evidence boundary. For EXACT_CANDIDATE_ONLY, use only the first "
            "selected input. For EXACT_CANDIDATE_AND_CANONICAL_DEPENDENCIES, keep the "
            "first selected input as the sole candidate under evaluation and consume "
            "each remaining exact qualified dependency's semantic_payload as evidence "
            "for that "
            "candidate's cross-layer claims. A reference-only BookDesign field is not "
            "missing evidence when its exact referenced dependency supplies the "
            "semantics. Do not consume prior qualification verdicts, demand downstream "
            "plans that cannot legally exist at the candidate's stage, or infer anything "
            "outside the frozen candidate-and-dependency envelope. Copy layer, profile_id, "
            "profile_version, profile_hash, capability_id, skill_ref, criterion, and "
            "candidate evidence identities exactly. Return one verdict per criterion. "
            "A non-PASS verdict must include a concrete repair_directive; PASS must "
            "leave repair_directive empty. Do not activate, revise, or replace the "
            "candidate, and do not infer evidence outside the frozen candidate."
        )
    if stage == "world_candidates.generate":
        return (
            "Generate only bounded candidate world transitions from the supplied frozen Foundation, Intent and accepted Reality. "
            "Copy all Authority references exactly. Propose hard preconditions, optional preparation paths, costs, "
            "consequences, information scope and soft assumptions separately. Never omit a hard predicate to make "
            "an event eligible. Preparation steps are proposals, not completed facts. Use explicit local: names "

            "OFF_CAMERA and UNDERCURRENT proposals must not grant Reader or character knowledge."
        )
    if stage == "world_candidates.evaluate":
        return (
            "Evaluate every supplied candidate exactly once against the frozen Director dimensions. "

    if stage in _PLANNING_STAGES:
        contract = (
            "Return only the planning candidate defined by the frozen output schema. "

            "verbatim and never replace it with a logical label, ordinal, title, or "
            "newly invented identifier. Keep Timeline containers and cross-cutting "
            "Narrative Arcs orthogonal. "
        )
        if stage == "book_plan.generate":
            contract += (
                "For world_realization and character_realization, every CURRENT "
                "entity's realization_level must be at least the top-level "

        elif stage == "arc_plan.generate":
            contract += (

                "volume_plan followed by planning_command."
                "arc_scope_volume_plan_version_ids. Each arc_segments[]."
                "volume_plan_version_id must copy one identifier from that exact "
                "scope, and each narrative_segment_id must copy a Narrative Segment "

            )
        elif stage == "chapter_group_plan.generate":
            contract += (
                "Copy planning_command.narrative_search_planning_horizon."

                "and make narrative_event_chain cover every Chapter without placing "

        elif stage == "chapter_plan.generate":
            contract += (
                "Produce an executable Chapter plan: bind its exact Timeline and Arc "
                "references, declare Primary/Secondary/Touch/Hold Arc work, knowledge "

    if stage == "memo":

            "learned facts into one Character Knowledge event. Use only the status "
            "field with UNKNOWN, SUSPECTED, KNOWN, or FORGOTTEN; leave the generic "
            "state field null. "
            "In character_belief_changes, use only stance with BELIEVES, DOUBTS, "
            "DISBELIEVES, or UNCERTAIN plus belief_confidence from zero to one; use "
            "from_stance only for an exact accepted baseline and leave generic state, "
            "status, from_state, and from_status null. "
            "In relationship_changes, always copy both directed graph endpoints into "
            "source_id and target_id; entity_id cannot replace an endpoint, and the "
            "generic character_id field must remain null. "

    if stage.startswith("quality_"):

                "that is not primarily Simplified Chinese as FAILED; Authority "
                "acceptance alone is not evidence of language compliance."

    return _bind_language_contract(
        realization_instruction
